title: A photovoltaic defect segmentation framework integrating domain knowledge and fine-tuned SAM (PV-SAM)
what_it_is: SAM (ViT-B/L/H) with a homomorphic-filter pre-step, DBSCAN-generated prompts and an HQ-SAM-style side network fusing early, final and mask-decoder features, trained on UCF-EL (9,022 train / 2,234 test, random split). Full text: ViT-H gives 54.6% mIoU, 512 px input; claims +20.7 mIoU over U-Net at 512 px.
why_it_could_help_us: Only pixel-level EL defect segmentation with a fine-tuned SAM that the tools returned; its side-network recipe (early + final ViT features upsampled to 256x256 + channel attention) is a ready design for a SAM side branch next to the house net, and the homomorphic filter targets the inter-source contrast spread (ARTS/CFVS/CSIR/BMRK/SDLE).
risk_or_reason_against: Random image-level split on UCF-EL (module leakage likely), mIoU over defect classes not crack relF1@2, U-Net baseline weak; mask output is 256x256 upsampled, so 1 to 2 px cracks are below its native grid; ViT-H at 1024 px costly.

title: A High-Quality Segmentation Framework for Photovoltaic Cells Based on Visual Foundation Model
what_it_is: Same authors as PV-SAM; title only (no abstract in index). Likely the preprint of PV-SAM.
why_it_could_help_us: Track only to avoid double counting PV-SAM.

title: Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
what_it_is: Controlled study: DINOv2 adapted with BitFit, LoRA ranks, full FT vs plain U-Net and ResU-Net from scratch, on polyp, breast US, dermoscopy, with external test sets. Full text: in-domain parity, but the adapted VFM wins on all 8 external sets; U-Nets give finer boundaries (NSD at 2/224) and DINOv2 more often misses small lesions entirely; BitFit or LoRA equals full FT; needed rank depends on domain.
why_it_could_help_us: Maps directly onto our split: E1 recall on unseen modules (VFM should help) vs 1 to 2 px precision (patch grid hurts, CNN wins). Argues for a hybrid where the house HRNet/U-Net++ keeps the pixel path and a small-capacity adapted VFM adds context, with LoRA rank swept on our data.
risk_or_reason_against: Medical RGB/US data, lesions not lines; external sets are different hospitals, not new module layouts; 224 px; one VFM.

title: How to build the best medical image segmentation algorithm using foundation models: a comprehensive empirical study with Segment Anything Model
what_it_is: 18 SAM fine-tuning combinations on 17 radiology datasets (abstract only). Findings: PEFT in both encoder and decoder is best, architecture has small impact, extra self-supervised training of SAM on domain images improves results.
why_it_could_help_us: Ready protocol for any SAM/SAM2 arm (P002): adapt encoder and decoder with PEFT, not decoder only; supports continued SSL of the VFM on our 11.9k unlabelled pool before supervised tuning.
risk_or_reason_against: Radiology organs, blob-like targets; gains over task-specific nets only "slightly better".

title: Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning of Segment Anything Model for Biomedical Imaging

why_it_could_help_us: Cuts the search space for the PEFT grid on a SAM/SAM2 arm (which blocks to adapt rather than LoRA vs adapter vs VPT).

title: Plug-and-play segment anything model improves nnUNet performance (nnSAM)

why_it_could_help_us: The cheapest test of "VFM context added to the house net": frozen encoder, one concat, no change to the pixel path that carries 1 to 2 px cracks. Aimed at E1 recall and rare inactive.
risk_or_reason_against: Gains shrink as data grows (5 to 20 images); we have 478 cells; 256 px organ masks.

title: SAUGE: Taming SAM for Uncertainty-Aligned Multi-Granularity Edge Detection

why_it_could_help_us: Models annotator granularity disagreement explicitly, which is our 1 to 2 px jitter problem; cross-dataset generalisation is the E1 recall issue.
risk_or_reason_against: Edges in natural images; needs multiple annotators or blended labels (we have one per cell).

why_it_could_help_us: The silent-rate probe is a cheap label-free check of whether a frozen VFM fires on EL cracks before any arm is opened.
risk_or_reason_against: Box supervision, civil cracks wider than 2 px.
